query:
WITH jeddah_residents AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT bc.id, bc.dependent_seq_no
    FROM estishraf_llm_border_crossings_impala bc
    JOIN estishraf_llm_home_location hl ON bc.id = hl.id
    WHERE hl.city = 'جدة'
),
international_flights AS (
    SELECT 
        bc.exit_location_name,
        bc.destination,
        bc.exit_date
    FROM estishraf_llm_border_crossings_impala bc
    JOIN jeddah_residents jr ON bc.id = jr.id AND bc.dependent_seq_no = jr.dependent_seq_no
    WHERE bc.exit_date >= '2025-01-01' AND bc.exit_date < '2026-01-01'
      AND bc.exit_location_name IN ('مطار الملك خالد الدولي (الرياض)', 'مطار الملك عبدالعزيز الدولي (جدة)')
      AND bc.destination IS NOT NULL 
      AND bc.destination != 'nan'
      AND bc.destination != ''
),
ranked_destinations AS (
    SELECT 
        exit_location_name AS airport,
        destination,
        COUNT(*) AS flight_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY exit_location_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) as rank
    FROM international_flights
    GROUP BY exit_location_name, destination
)
SELECT airport, destination, flight_count
FROM ranked_destinations
WHERE rank <= 5
ORDER BY airport, rank LIMIT 20000
